speaker: abel_garnish
text: It came up before we did. A prentice from Blackfriars, and the comedy wrapped as if rain were a personal enemy. No grease on the leaf. Two words in a smaller hand than mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Those two are hers. Beau struck, bien over it. Sire struck, madame over it. I am not lending you a third.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will enter the two, and I will not enter a speech I cannot see. Nick, the vowel. Do not give me a new French. Give me the one she mended, and keep the rest of the line where I left it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If I take the breath before the courtesy, the vowel stays in the front of the mouth. Where it was, I had to swallow the noun to reach the rhyme.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then take the breath before it, Nick. The line will wait for thee. Thou art not inventing a language. Thou art saying the word she wrote.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Cleaner. Thou didst not pinch it. That is the whole of the praise, and it is enough for a morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I dropped nothing. I will not drop it on Thursday either, if Thursday is this book. I would like to know which book Thursday is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday's book, for me, is an old duke and forty lines. It is a part. It is not this comedy, and it is not a speech I am copying onto a roll this morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Forty lines of a duke, and not a line of me in them, I suppose. You may keep your duke. I came to know whether the slippers are this afternoon.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The slippers are Thursday, Will. This morning the boards are for the play we have at two. I am not teaching a jig over a book that has just come home.

speaker: will_kemp
text: By my hose, the boards are clear enough for twenty bars. Arthur has the kirtle. Let us see whether he can scold without tripping, and then I will stop.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The hem is short. I will not trip if you do not turn the whole stage into a shoe. I have no lines to count. I have a scold, and a box on the ear when the shoes go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Save the heels for Thursday, Will. A scold and a cobbler can wait on a promise already made. I am not showing you another book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I did not ask for another book. I asked for a dance. You are very careful of books this week. Marry, keep them.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Enough of the shoes. The leaf is entered as two words and no more. Master Kemp, the jig has a day. This day is not it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Twenty bars would become two hundred, and I have a cittern to keep whole until Thursday. Arthur, hang the kirtle. Nick, the vowel is yours. Do not improve it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not improve it. A mended word is a word. I can say it, and I can stop.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I can stop too. The hem can wait where Edith left it. I am not asking for a longer skirt in a rehearsal that is not the dance.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Forty lines are a part I already have in my legs. I am not speaking them here, where a jig would answer them. Augustine, the book is home. That was the errand.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The book is home. The dance is Thursday. I am satisfied, which I do not say often before noon.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I am unsatisfied on purpose, and I will live until Thursday. You have your vowel, King Nick. Do not lose it. I' faith, I have lost worse.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nobody is losing a leaf. Two words. A duke's forty, not spoken this hour. A jig with a day on it. I can write that without a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Write it so. I am for the old man at two, and for my own stair after. God keep you.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two words, and the leaf agrees with itself. I will not touch it again this morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And you. I have the breath in the right place. I will not move it.
